title: Embedding endpoint: fastpath prefetch + speculative kernel selection to compress tail latency
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Embeddings API shows long tail p99+ latency spikes under mixed load. Root causes from prior profiling point to: (1) late KV/cache population for short queries, (2) suboptimal kernel choice during cold paths, and (3) microbatching starvation when small concurrent requests interleave. Goal: reduce p95/p99 by at least 30% without regressing median latency or increasing cost >5%. This ticket implements a two-pronged runtime optimization: (A) a fastpath prefetch and KV priming flow for small/short-ctx embedding requests, and (B) speculative kernel selection with lightweight runtime heuristics that choose faster, lower-precision kernels when quality impact is estimated to be negligible. Secondary work: introduce a hierarchical batching queue that separates ultra-low-latency singletons from larger microbatches to avoid head-of-line blocking.
acceptance_criteria: p95 embedding latency reduced by >=20% and p99 reduced by >=30% on benchmark mix (mix: 60% short single-sentence requests, 30% multi-sentence, 10% bulk) compared to baseline run-2026-02-01
no more than 5% increase in token-cost per embedding on average across test workload
automated unit + integration tests for fastpath prefetch and speculative kernel fallback exist and pass in CI
dashboard exposes new metrics: fastpath_hit, speculative_kernel_used, kv_prefill_latency, hierarchical_queue_wait_ms
gradual rollout plan documented (canary 1%, 5%, 25%, 100%) with automatic rollback on p99 regression >10%
updates: 2026-02-26: Initial profiling completed. Short requests (<= 64 tokens) have 2.3x higher cache miss rate than longer requests. Observed kernel swap latency ~7ms under cold path.
2026-03-02: Proof-of-concept KV prefill implemented in runtime branch eng/fastpath-prefetch. Local benchmark shows p95 improvement ~18% for short-only synthetic load.

2026-03-05: Evaluated speculative kernel candidates (fp16, int8-quantized kernels). int8 candidate reduced per-token execution by 25% but needs quality eval on representative prompts; creating separate eval job.
2026-03-09: Hierarchical queue prototype implemented in scheduler branch eng/hier-batch. Reduced head-of-line wait for singleton flows by ~12ms median in lab tests.

2026-03-12: Integration test flake fixed. Preparing canary rollout plan; will enable fastpath-prefetch behind runtime feature-flag first, then enable speculative kernel via controlled gating after QA.
comments: PM review (Sofia Kim, 2026-03-03): Request to keep a conservative default for speculative kernels — must be off by default for customers with strict quality requirements.
Design review (Liam O'Connor, 2026-03-06): Suggests exposing per-model opt-in list for speculative kernels rather than global flag to avoid cross-model regressions.
Security note (Priya S., 2026-03-07): KV prefill needs to respect tenant isolation and not leak metadata between customers. Confirmed prefill uses tenant-scoped caches only.
Infra (Jun Wei, 2026-03-10): Need to validate memory pressure patterns when prefill increases concurrent warm KV entries; added memory watermark guard to scheduler.
Eng sig-off (Marco Rivera, 2026-03-12): Ready to begin 1% canary for fastpath-prefetch after deploying telemetry dashboards. Will not enable speculative kernels in canary until quality eval passes.
